title.en: DeepSeek releases R1, an open-source reasoning model that shocks global markets
title.zhHans: DeepSeek 发布 R1，开源推理模型震撼全球市场

searchSummary.en: DeepSeek R1: an open-source reasoning model matching OpenAI’s best at a fraction of the cost. How a Chinese AI lab shocked global markets in 2025.
searchSummary.zhHans: DeepSeek R1：2025 年 1 月发布的开源推理模型，以极低成本达到 OpenAI 顶级水平。了解这家中国 AI 实验室如何震惊全球市场。

summary.en: On January 20, 2025, Chinese AI lab DeepSeek released R1, an open-source reasoning model matching OpenAI's o1 on key benchmarks at a fraction of the training cost. Using Mixture-of-Experts architecture and Group Relative Policy Optimization, R1 achieved o1-level reasoning for approximately 1/20th of the training compute. On January 27, the release triggered a global stock market selloff that erased $593 billion from Nvidia's market cap — the largest single-day value loss in history — and DeepSeek became the most-downloaded free app on the US iOS App Store.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 1 月 20 日，中国 AI 实验室 DeepSeek 发布了 R1，一个在关键基准上以极低训练成本匹配 OpenAI o1 的开源推理模型。利用混合专家架构和组相对策略优化，R1 以约 1/20 的训练计算量实现了 o1 级别的推理能力。1 月 27 日，该发布引发了全球股市抛售，Nvidia 市值蒸发 5930 亿美元——创下历史上最大的单日市值损失——DeepSeek 成为美国 iOS App Store 下载量最大的免费应用。

narrative.en: DeepSeek R1 was the moment the AI industry's assumptions about compute supremacy collapsed. For two years, the dominant narrative was that frontier AI models required enormous compute clusters — billions of dollars of Nvidia GPUs. OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic had each spent billions building their training infrastructure. DeepSeek, a Chinese lab spun out of quantitative hedge fund High-Flyer, proved that a 671B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model could match o1's reasoning performance using far fewer resources. The key innovation was GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning technique that dramatically improved training efficiency for reasoning. The model was released under the MIT license, fully open-weight with a technical report. The market reaction on January 27 was unprecedented: Nvidia dropped 17% in a single day, losing $593 billion in market cap. The Nasdaq fell 3%. Tech billionaires lost nearly $100 billion combined. The selloff reflected a fundamental revaluation: if frontier AI could be built with fewer GPUs, the entire Nvidia growth thesis — and the $500B AI infrastructure buildout — needed re-examination. DeepSeek R1's political impact was equally profound. It triggered immediate scrutiny of US AI chip export controls, raised questions about the effectiveness of the Biden administration's semiconductor restrictions, and sparked a wave of government responses — from Italy's antitrust investigation to discussions in the US Congress about competitiveness. In the AI community, R1's open-source release democratized reasoning capabilities. Fine-tuned derivatives like DeepSeek-R1-Distill appeared within days. By proving that open-source models could match closed-source reasoning, DeepSeek R1 permanently changed the AI landscape.
narrative.zhHans: DeepSeek R1 是 AI 行业关于算力至上假设崩塌的时刻。两年来，主导叙事是前沿 AI 模型需要巨大的计算集群——价值数十亿美元的 Nvidia GPU。OpenAI、Google 和 Anthropic 各自花费数十亿美元建设训练基础设施。DeepSeek，一家从量化对冲基金 High-Flyer 分拆出来的中国实验室，证明了 671B 参数的混合专家模型可以用少得多的资源匹配 o1 的推理性能。关键创新是 GRPO（组相对策略优化），一种大幅提高推理训练效率的强化学习技术。该模型以 MIT 许可证发布，完全开源权重并附带技术报告。1 月 27 日的市场反应史无前例：Nvidia 单日下跌 17%，市值蒸发 5930 亿美元。纳斯达克下跌 3%。科技亿万富翁合计损失近 1000 亿美元。抛售反映了一个根本性的重估：如果前沿 AI 可以用更少的 GPU 构建，那么整个 Nvidia 的增长逻辑——以及 5000 亿美元的 AI 基础设施建设——需要重新审视。DeepSeek R1 的政治影响同样深远。它立即引发了对美国 AI 芯片出口管制的审视，对拜登政府半导体限制措施的有效性提出了质疑，并引发了一系列政府回应——从意大利的反垄断调查到美国国会关于竞争力的讨论。在 AI 社区中，R1 的开源发布使推理能力民主化。微调衍生版本（如 DeepSeek-R1-Distill）在数天内出现。通过证明开源模型可以匹配闭源推理能力，DeepSeek R1 永久改变了 AI 格局。

Rendered US chip export controls less effective. Established DeepSeek as a permanent force in AI. Triggered global policy and regulatory responses.
